mission: Serve one explicitly authorized SNKRDUNK recovery validation under the existing natural scheduled singleton

impacts.reason: Explicit durable recovery intent is consumed once by the existing scheduled singleton. No cron/command/concurrency change; all source-denial, exact lineage, raw evidence, ordinal, reservation and successful-resume guards preserved.

routes: Existing scheduled SNKRDUNK singleton; one explicit recovery intent only
dependencies: Existing exact writer and current approved/manual mapping
Shared source-budget services; no schema change
impact.deployment_impact: Staging API and one existing SNKRDUNK collector; unchanged service command and cron.

recovery.procedure: Block only an unattempted planned recovery work ID; retain source pause and all evidence. Rebuild retained staging collector if required. Normal admission re-pauses immediately on fresh required denial.
recovery.trigger: Required denial, identity refusal, failed reservation/lease settlement, lineage change or absent/stale recovery proof
recovery.backup: No migration, mapping change, persisted probe price or historical rewrite. Retained source/deployment and transactional hypothesis rollback.

verification.observation_window: One explicit scheduled recovery validation, then subsequent natural RAW turns for captures/no-listings, source-health and reservation settlement; no repeated recovery after refusal.
